title: Involvement of the serotonergic system in the control of impulsivity in Tourette disorder : ARITEP
official: Involvement of the serotonergic system in the control of impulsivity in Tourette disorder : ARITEP
summary: Main objective: To determine the correlative links between the availability of serotonergic 5-HT2A receptors and the variations in impulsivity measured in adults with Tourette's syndrome during treatment begin in the routine care.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Male or Female
2. Diagnosed with a Tourette Disorder following the DSM-5
3. Age between 18-65 years
4. Member of a social security scheme in France
5. Freely-given informed consent to participate to this study (written form)
6. With a current treatment by aripiprazole already scheduled
7. With Tics compatible with TEP/fMRI exams
8. Having (for women only) effective contraception throughout participation in the study.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Male or Female
2. A serious not controlled psychiatric comorbidity
3. A serious, evolving or debilitating pathology with a potential influence on the study
4. Drug-taking with serotonergic effects (e.g., amphetamine, cocaine, MDMA, SSRIs, mianserin)
5. Contraindication for fMRI and PET (e.g., pacemaker, ferromagnetic implant, claustrophobia)
6. Women breastfeeding
7. Protected or restricted person (administratively or in judicial terms)
8. Participants to another study with radiations or radiotracers since less of one year, participants to a concomitant study
9. Do not speak french
